# Halcyon PRST fixtures (generated by the reference tool)

Produced 2026-10-10 by tau-alpha's `tools/halcyon_assets.py` (read-only use: `apo_to_preset` + `pack_presets`) from the `.txt` Equalizer APO profiles here
(`cans.txt` is the reference tool's own self-test profile; `bright.txt` adds the no-Q default, `Hz` without a space, `LS`/`HS`/`PEQ` spellings and a 16 kHz cut).
`cans.prst` and `bright.prst` are the single-preset files, `mixed.prst` a control preset (MY CONTROLS) plus the raw CANS preset, `expected.json` the tool's
reported preamp and peak boost. Tau Omega's `halcyon` module must reproduce these bytes exactly. The tau-alpha repo is not edited; nothing here is shared as a file.
